name: Marek
source:
"No, That's wrong. What I want is... your guys lives."

A boy that controls puppets.
Using a a creepy puppet he attacks the protagonist's group that is fleeing the Veke Kingdom.
He has a strange attachment to his puppets and will never let go of them.
